How to enter

Finish the main story to open Cheats in the Progress menu, then unlock each cheat with its challenge. In free roam, press Up to bring out the phone, hold L1 and R1, and enter the sequence on the d-pad.

Story mode only, not GTA Online. A cheat turns off saving, trophies and achievements for the session, so make a manual save first.
